# Data Source: tfe_saml_settings

(Only for Terraform Enterprise) Gets information on SAML settings.

This requires admin token configuration. See example usage for incorporating an admin token in your provider config.

## Example Usage

```python
import constructs as constructs
import cdktf as cdktf
# Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
# See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.
import ...gen.providers.tfe as tfe
class MyConvertedCode(cdktf.TerraformStack):
    def __init__(self, scope, name):
        super().__init__(scope, name)
        # Terraform Variables are not always the best fit for getting inputs in the context of Terraform CDK.
        #     You can read more about this at https://cdk.tf/variables
        admin_token = cdktf.TerraformVariable(self, "admin_token",
            description="An admin access token"
        )
        hostname = cdktf.TerraformVariable(self, "hostname",
            default="app.terraform.io",
            description="The HCP Terraform or Enterprise hostname."
        )
        token = cdktf.TerraformVariable(self, "token",
            description="An access token"
        )
        tfe.provider.TfeProvider(self, "tfe",
            hostname=hostname.string_value,
            token=token.string_value
        )
        tfe_admin = tfe.provider.TfeProvider(self, "tfe_4",
            alias="admin",
            hostname=hostname.string_value,
            token=admin_token.string_value
        )
        tfe.data_tfe_saml_settings.DataTfeSamlSettings(self, "foo",
            provider=tfe_admin
        )
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `acs_consumer_url` (String) ACS Consumer (Recipient) URL.
- `attr_groups` (String) Name of the SAML attribute that determines team membership.
- `attr_site_admin` (String) Site admin access role.
- `attr_username` (String) Name of the SAML attribute that determines the user's username.
- `authn_requests_signed` (Boolean) Whether `<samlp:AuthnRequest>` messages are signed.
- `certificate` (String) Request and assertion signing certificate.
- `debug` (Boolean) Whether debug mode is enabled, which means that the SAMLResponse XML will be displayed on the login page.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether SAML single sign-on is enabled.
- `id` (String) ID of the SAML settings. It is always `saml`.
- `idp_cert` (String) PEM encoded X.509 Certificate as provided by the IdP configuration.
- `metadata_url` (String) Metadata (Audience) URL.
- `old_idp_cert` (String) Previous version of the PEM encoded X.509 Certificate as provided by the IdP configuration.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) The private key used for request and assertion signing.
- `provider_type` (String) The type of identity provider used. One of `okta`, `entra`, `saml`, or `unknown`.
- `signature_digest_method` (String) Signature Digest Method.
- `signature_signing_method` (String) Signature Signing Method.
- `site_admin_role` (String) Site admin access role.
- `slo_endpoint_url` (String) Single Log Out URL.
- `sso_api_token_session_timeout` (Number) Single Sign On session timeout in seconds.
- `sso_endpoint_url` (String) Single Sign On URL.
- `team_management_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Terraform Enterprise is set to manage team membership.
- `want_assertions_signed` (Boolean) Whether `<saml:Assertion>` elements are signed.
